description: AI configuration used during the Invoice Reconciliation & Review exercise. No credentials. Earlier versions of changed files are kept as named snapshots in ai-workflow/snapshots/ and per-phase reviews in ai-workflow/reviews/.

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code version 2.1.295 (stated by the author) was the development tool: an orchestrator session plus two subagents. Orchestrator model: Sonnet 5.5, ID claude-sonnet-5-5 (stated by the author). The subagents are declared with model: inherit, i.e. they use the orchestrator model. No tool settings were changed beyond the project files listed here.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: No plugins or editor extensions were configured for this project.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: Application integration: Gemini via google-genai 2.29.0, model gemini-2.5-flash (recorded in every cache entry), temperature 0, max_output_tokens 2048, timeout 60 s, 2 retries with backoff. Extraction uses response_mime_type application/json with response_schema RawExtraction; notes and insight use plain text. Saved real responses are in data/model_cache/ and are replayed without a key.

skills.notes: generate-assignment-data (from the starter pack) guided the dataset phase (Phase 6). verify-reconciliation is kept unchanged but marked not-used: it refers to scripts/eval.py, a 98 percent accuracy gate and ruff/mypy, none of which exist in this project; it was not used by the loop.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: CLAUDE.md holds the non-negotiable rules and the implement-test-review loop. The implementer subagent writes code per phase (no live calls); the reviewer subagent is read-only and returns PASS or CHANGES_REQUESTED. Review outputs: ai-workflow/reviews/phase-<n>-round-<m>.md. docs/DECISIONS.md D6 was corrected in Phase 8 (it earlier said no subagents); see ai-workflow/snapshots/DECISIONS.md.phase-8.md.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: No Claude Code hooks are configured (there is no settings file and no hook script under .claude/). tools/baseline.py is a plain script run manually by the orchestrator to copy the project to .baseline/ for diff-based reviews instead of git; it is not triggered automatically.

prompts_and_rules.notes: Application prompts are versioned by filename and the version is part of the cache key. Business rules come only from data/inputs/domain.md and docs/DECISIONS.md.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: No MCP servers or tool configuration are defined in the project (.claude/ contains only agents/ and skills/). User-level settings were not copied.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: No project permission settings file exists (default permission prompts). Variable names only: GEMINI_API_KEY, GEMINI_MODEL, MODEL_MODE, USE_SIMULATIONS, SIMULATED_FAILURES. The real .env is excluded from the submission and gitignored.
